title: Square Frame Items
description: Adjusts item models to better fit into a square window.
body: This pack adjusts most item models to better fit into a square-shaped window. I made it so I can record YouTube Shorts. Honestly I'm not totally satisfied with the placement of all items, so it'll most certainly get tweaks and updates in the future. I'm actually pretty fine with the default placement of block items, so this pack doesn't change those.
